status: Exploratory synthetic extension; not a preregistered empirical study
private_signal_model: Balanced binary truth; symmetric human/agent error; humans conditionally independent. All agents, including an agent proposer, share one Bernoulli error with probability rho; otherwise iid. Marginal agent error is invariant to rho.
echo_model: An exposed agent reviewer copies the displayed upstream decision with probability eta_source; otherwise keeps its private judgment. Copy coins are independent conditional on private signals. eta_H and eta_A may differ. No new task evidence is generated during discussion.

cost_model.full_trace_explanation: 2 private humans + 6 private agents + 10 additional exposed agent responses + gold + 6*0.05 private-commit overhead = 7.3

phase.objective: Minimize final error within budget; expected cost breaks numerical error ties; report tie counts. Also retain the deployment-loss optimum for comparison.

learning.estimation: Full_trace: pre/post paired judgments identify source-specific echo using switches among initially discordant reviews; moments identify private ability/rho. Ignore_echo uses exactly the same observations but forces eta=0. Randomized_exposure: disjoint blinded/exposed tasks crossed with source type, estimates eta = 1 - exposed_disagreement / blind_disagreement; uses blind tasks for private agent moments. Final_uniform evaluates one candidate at a time using its final gold-labeled result and actual call cost.
learning.information_boundary: True parameters are available to the environment and exact evaluation only; learner decisions use purchased observations. Known candidate protocols, costs, homogeneous error family and binary symmetry are structural assumptions.
learning.accounting: Current acquisitions precede deployment. Production truth is not fed back for free. Net=1-3*error-0.02*production_cost-(acquisition_cost+0.5*changed)/4096. Regret excludes acquisition/switching cost. Oracle success accepts every deployment-loss tie within 1e-10. No free counterfactual responses or labels.
learning.uncertainty: Across independent trajectory replicates, normal Monte Carlo 95% CI = mean +/- 1.96*sample_sd/sqrt(128). Policy contrasts paired by world and replicate. These are simulation mean intervals, not empirical population intervals.

limitations: Exact optimum is over a finite catalog, not all graphs
Blind protocols remove copying by construction; they do not cure intrinsic correlation
No beneficial exchange of rationales or new evidence
Precommitment is assumed not to change the latent private signal or later copying propensity
Human independence and all numerical parameters are hypotheses, not measured properties
Serial_last passes only the immediately prior verdict, not an accumulating transcript
Error is disagreement with binary task truth, not an empirical PR defect escape rate
